summary: Senior systems engineering and technical program manager with over a decade of experience leading large-scale, complex software and simulation development programs, managing up to 70+ systems, software, test engineers, technical artists and game developers. Manages budgets, scope and schedules of $50M+ programs, including subcontractor oversight, cross-functional team leadership, and proposal pricing and estimating. Background spans mechanical engineering, hardware-software integration, enterprise system architecture, simulator and training system design, and requirements engineering, with a bridge role between technical domains and financial processes. Holds an active secret security clearance and is bilingual in Arabic and English.
